title: Searching for Primes: A Neural AlphaZero Approach to a Factoring Game
summary: We study a one-player token game on an $N\times N$ board where tokens slide along diagonals or duplicate onto neighbouring ones to form a combinatorial rectangle $R\times S$. A conserved integer weight $W'$ and a strict monovariant guarantee $O(N^2)$-length solutions, placing the game in $\mathsf{NP}$. We prove that reaching a final position factors this $2N$-bit $W'$ into two $N$-bit factors $V,M < 2^N$ that encode the rectangle's rows and columns.
